⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Today was our first time visiting Pet Supplies Plus, and I am so glad we stopped in!

We had just left another pet store after a very disappointing experience while trying to get some guidance on freshwater fish for our 10-gallon tank. As we were driving, we happened to see Pet Supplies Plus and decided to stop in to see what they had.

From the moment we walked in, the experience was completely different. The store was very clean, the cashier immediately welcomed us, and we quickly found the fish section.

While we were looking at the bettas, an associate named Ben came over and started telling us about a beautiful betta he really liked. It was such a genuine interaction and immediately made us feel comfortable asking him for some guidance.

Ben was incredible. He was extremely knowledgeable, patient, and thorough. He answered every question we had in great detail and gave us wonderful guidance on which fish would be the best fit for our 10-gallon tank and our current experience level. He never made us feel rushed or like we were asking too many questions. He took the time to explain our options and helped us make choices we felt confident about.

What I especially appreciated was how willing he was to help us choose the colors of the fish we wanted so our children could name them and make the experience even more special. When we asked what food would be best, Ben personally walked us over to the aisle, showed us the different options, and gave us his recommendations.

THIS is what spectacular customer service looks like.

Ben truly exceeded our expectations. You can tell when someone genuinely cares about what they do, and that absolutely came through in the way he spoke about the fish and took the time to help us. His knowledge, patience, kindness, and passion completely turned our day around.

Pet Supplies Plus gained a new customer today because of Ben. We will absolutely be returning. Please make sure he receives the recognition he deserves!

And if Ben happens to see this: thank you for helping make our son’s birthday so special. Our six new fish have happily acclimated to their new home and are already very loved. Our boys had the best time coming up with some amazing names for their new little fish friends. (picture attached)

Thank you again, Ben, for taking the time to help our family and for making what started as a disappointing day turn into such a wonderful memory. We truly appreciate you!

RUDE GROOMING STAFF!

I have lived in this area my whole life would always go to this Pet Supplies Plus for any and everything pet related. I even remember when this store was at the Dollar Tree location on Harlem closer to Higgins.

I normally have great experiences with the grooming, services, and products provided here however on Tuesday 4/15, I did not. My golden retriever was scheduled for a bath and brush. I called ahead and moved his appointment up an hour as I was running ahead of schedule. I did mention on the phone that I was going to be 15-20 mins late and they were ok with it at the time.

When I got to the store, and gave the groomer mine and my dog's name, she very blatantly and obviously looked up at the clock and rolled her eyes and said "you are 20 minutes late, you're going to have to reschedule." She said it in such a rude manner that at first I thought she was joking. I asked if we could just have the original appointment time back and I was told that that slot was already given to another dog.

I understand the importance of being on time but I did mention that I was going to be a little late when I called ahead. She did not have to be so rude while explaining the situation. I ended up rescheduling the appointment for another day, but then canceling it because the Morton Grove Pet Supplies Plus was more than accommodating and was able to take my dog for a bath and brush last minute.

My dog was scheduled with Amy that day. I am not sure if Amy was the one being rude to me so I do not want falsely accuse anyone but that was only name I have to reference.

I have never had a bad experience at this store but it just goes to show how one bad experience can really ruin it going forward.
